target_customer: NHS GP practices in England, paying per automated registration or via subscription
problem: GP practice staff spend hours on patient registration, eligibility checks, triage and booking, while patient access to care is poor.
business_model: B2B SaaS to GP practices with free tier and a per registration fee, plus booking products
product_category: Clinical AI for primary care admin, triage and booking

founders.name: Raj Paul
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him an NHS Clinical Entrepreneur and ex management consultant delivering intelligent automation for global banks. The launch post and Sifted name the same person as Raj Kohli.

founders.name: Peter Huang
founders.background_notes: Web engineer at Monzo per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Identity checks against NHS records and writing data into EMIS and SystmOne clinical systems needed integration and clinical safety work, later registered as a Class 1 medical device.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with GP clinical systems, G-Cloud listing and medical device registration raise barriers, though the workflow could be copied by established vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Online consultation vendors served GP practices, but no dated source shows them copying automated registration. Healthtech-1 reports 1,600+ practices by the site's own claim.

market_need_then: The company cites patient satisfaction at a 25 year low in NHS access; the YC launch post reports its first automation live in 100+ practices and saving over 1,000 staff hours per week, company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses healthtech1.uk and bookable.health for the booking product.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain outcome claims for practices and patients.

branding.brand_signature: Bookable, the booking product name, with the goal that every appointment is bookable
branding.community_and_virality: Company site links to a Guardian article (Sept 2026) and a Digital Health briefing (Oct 2026), content not seen.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic company name with a more memorable product name Bookable; no source shows the brand itself driving growth.

outcome_analysis: Healthtech-1 grew from a registration automation into a 40 person company claiming coverage of 1,600+ NHS GP practices, with a mid 2024 seed round led by Moonfire. Wide practice adoption of a narrow admin wedge, and a UK buying channel through G-Cloud, point to real product market fit, while later rounds remain unverified.
notes: Seed reported as GBP 2.7M by Digital Health and Vestbee and 3.5M USD by Sifted (Sifted dated 2024-09-18 per YC page); amount recorded in USD from Sifted. The Digital Health page returned 403 so its text was seen only in search snippets. Signalbase claim of 5.0M and PitchBook Nov 2025 deal are unverified. Founder name inconsistent (Paul vs Kohli). No dated competitor source near the batch was found; Accurx, eConsult and PATCHS appear only in undated or later pages. Founded year 2022 per YC, PitchBook says 2021.
